description.ES: Terminas el grado. Puedes estudiar un máster de dos años o empezar a trabajar ya.
description.EN: You are finishing your bachelor's. You can study a two-year master's or start working now.

sources: Tuition: scenario-assumptions.csv (scenario S001), annual_tuition_chf p75 / p50 / p25 for the pessimistic / neutral / optimistic case; 2 years (study_duration_years). Keys tuition.monthly.*.

Salaries: employed income p25 / p50 / p75 (synthetic-profiles.csv) scaled to the age of entry with the BFS LSE 2024 age curve (22 if you start now, 24 after the master's). Keys salary.startNow.*, salary.afterMaster.*.
No master's wage premium: the dataset has no education level and the BFS table we use is by age and position, so both paths pay the same at the same age. The only difference is the age of entry.
Living while studying: the flow model (students spend about 21 % less; the event's tuition replaces the learned one).

description.ES: Tu empresa te ofrece un puesto de responsabilidad en su oficina de Zurich. Tendrías que mudarte.
description.EN: Your company offers you a management role at its Zurich office. You would have to move.

sources: Catalogue S013 + S021. Pay rise: BFS LSE 2024, median wage of each management level / all positions at age 40 (ratio.promotion.*).

Living costs in Zurich: flow model city factors (groceries, restaurants, utilities...). Pay does not depend on the city in the dataset.
Career: SENIOR follows the BFS management curve from then on.

description.ES: Tu empresa recorta plantilla. Puedes aceptar enseguida un trabajo a media jornada o esperar uno como el que tenías.
description.EN: Your company cuts jobs. You can take a part-time job right away or wait for one like the one you had.

sources: Income while unemployed: median unemployed income / median employed income in synthetic-profiles.csv (ratio.unemployed). The dataset gives the unemployed almost no income; real Swiss unemployment insurance pays more, but it is not in our data.
Part-time pay: ratio.partTime (synthetic-profiles.csv); part-time workers get no December bonus in the ledger.
Length of the gap: 6 months as in catalogue S014; 12 and 3 months for the other cases are assumptions.
How likely job loss is: Eurostat une_rt_m, Switzerland (unemployment.*), about 8 % under 25 and 4 % from 25 to 74.
